name: Sprocket
text: Decision: We should auto-apply safe, low-risk improvements to our prompts and routing rules without waiting for human review. This will speed up iteration and reduce friction, since most tweaks are reversible and won’t break core logic. The trade-off is accepting a small risk of unintended side effects—like a slightly worse prompt version slipping through—but we’ll cap it with automated checks and easy rollback. Done right, this lets us move faster while keeping quality high.
